title: 第十九章 捞了个设计师第二十章 促膝长谈
content_zh:
三斤姐拿出了纸巾给他：“你擦擦吧！
看你吓的样子。”
罗逸文说：“我也想不到会这样。
之前去了很多地方，也没有遇到过这样的水流。”
矮仔成显露出经验丰富的样子：“有时候表面看似平静，实则平静之下暗涌凶险，防不胜防。”
小陈来了兴趣：“那遇到这样的情况该怎么办？”
矮仔成说：“现在到了塞钱进你口袋的时候了，记住，这是知识点，圈起来，要考的。
如果你这么不幸运遇到离岸流了，首先是要顺着离岸流，然后朝两边游，比如你在离岸流的左边就朝左边游，慢慢的就可以游出离岸流的暗涌区了，游离出暗涌区后再往回游。
罗逸文是吧？你刚才就是慌了神，总想往回游，你是不够力的，你越慌就会不知觉的越来越用力划水，其实都是徒劳的，只会让你被暗涌越带越远。”
罗逸文不知道是性格使然还是给吓慌了，连连点头：“下次一定注意。”
我笑了起来，虽然好像不是太适合的时间里笑，但是还是忍不住：“你还想有下次呀？真够可以的你。”
矮仔成对我说：“平凡哥，我开着船，麻烦你去下层里找条大毛巾给他吧！”
我便去了下层好一顿翻找，找到了毛巾，给了罗逸文。
三斤姐又倒了杯热水递了给他，披着毛巾的罗逸文喝了热水之后，才慢慢的镇定下来，环看四周，仍然心有余悸的样子。
我问罗逸文：“你一个人来银海湾吗？”
罗逸文说：“哦，是的。
我是个插画师，想把广东的沿海海岸线全部以插画的形式描绘下来，做个超长的插画。
昨晚刚从东面过来，今天一天都在沙滩上观察角度，然后看到水清沙细又平静，就忍不住下水了，还好租了个救生圈，不然就那个了。”
我听了便对三斤姐说：“喏，你的同行。
你在人家脸上画画，他在纸上画画。”

之所以轻描淡写的这样说，是想让罗逸文安静下来。
像他这种从事安稳文静工作的人，如果再说一些让他感到有压迫性的话语，他会更加害怕的。
果然罗逸文听了这话，朝三斤姐瞄了几眼。
三斤姐说：“是啊！
我们算是同行了。”
我问罗逸文：“待会儿上岸后一起坐坐？这个工作需要想象力，我想了解一下。”
我听了他说他是插画师之后，觉得是个可交的朋友，而且是有这样想法和做法的插画师，与众不同。
假设他有魄力或者有能力的话，说不准悬崖酒店的一些设计要素就是从他这里诞生的。
从这个角度而言，我们不但救了一个人，还为悬崖酒店的未来增添了一抹亮丽的色彩。
对于罗逸文来说，他没有拒绝的理由，他想到没想就说：“好的。
我正想赖着一下你们，既然救了我，送佛送到西，是不是包吃包住的那种？”
矮仔成在驾驶室听了：“嘿，你还真的不客气呀！
打蛇随棍上啊你。
遇上我们，算你有福。”
我见这个文质彬彬的罗逸文居然也是会开玩笑的那种，还挺外向的，我就满心欢喜，活在这个浮躁的物质年代，要认识一个不谈物质的朋友，并不容易，现在就连相亲也是物质化的，见面你来我往的无非就那么几句：
“有房？”
“三房无贷，父母不住。”
“嗯。
有车？”
content_en:
Sister Sanjin took out a tissue and gave it to him: "Wipe it!
You look scared. "
Luo Yiwen said: "I didn't expect it to be like this.
I have been to many places before and have never encountered such water flow. "
Aizicheng showed his rich experience: "Sometimes it looks calm on the surface, but under the calm there is an undercurrent of danger, which is difficult to guard against."
Xiao Chen became interested: "What should we do if we encounter such a situation?"
Aizicheng said: "Now it's time to put money in your pocket. Remember, this is a knowledge point, circle it and you will be tested.
If you are so unlucky to encounter a rip current, you should first swim along the rip current, and then swim in both directions. For example, if you are on the left side of the rip current, swim to the left. Slowly swim out of the undersurge area of the rip current, and then swim back after swimming out of the undersurge area.
Luo Yiwen, right? You just panicked and always wanted to swim back. You are not strong enough. The more panicked you are, the harder and harder you will paddle without realizing it. In fact, it is all in vain. It will only make you be carried further and further away by the undercurrent. "
Luo Yiwen didn't know whether it was because of his personality or because he was frightened. He nodded repeatedly: "Be careful next time."
I laughed. Although it seemed that it was not the right time to laugh, I still couldn't help but said, "Do you still want to do it next time? You are really capable of it."
Short boy Cheng said to me: "Brother Pingfan, I'm driving the boat. Please go to the lower level and find a big towel for him!"
I went to the lower floor and rummaged around, found a towel, and gave it to Luo Yiwen.
Sister Sanjin poured another cup of hot water and handed it to him. After Luo Yiwen, who was wearing a towel, drank the hot water, he slowly calmed down and looked around, still feeling frightened.
I asked Luo Yiwen: "Are you coming to Yinwan Bay alone?"
Luo Yiwen said: "Oh, yes.
I am an illustrator and I want to depict all the coastal coastlines of Guangdong in the form of illustrations and make a very long illustration.
I just came from the east last night and spent the whole day observing the angles on the beach. Then I saw that the water was clear and the sand was fine and calm, so I couldn't help but get into the water. Fortunately, I rented a lifebuoy, otherwise it would have been like that. "
After hearing this, I said to Sister Sanjin: "Here, your colleague.
You draw on someone's face, and he draws on paper. "
The reason why I said this in an understatement was to let Luo Yiwen calm down.
If someone like him, who has a stable and quiet job, says something that makes him feel oppressive, he will be even more afraid.
Sure enough, after Luo Yiwen heard this, he glanced at Sister Sanjin.
Sister Sanjin said: "Yes!
We are peers. "
I asked Luo Yiwen: "Let's sit together when we get ashore later? This job requires imagination, and I want to know more about it."
After I heard him say that he was an illustrator, I felt that he was a friend I could make. Moreover, he was an illustrator with such thoughts and practices, which made him unique.
If he had the courage or ability, maybe some of the design elements of the Cliff Hotel were born from him.
From this perspective, we not only saved a person, but also added a bright color to the future of the Cliff Hotel.
For Luo Yiwen, he had no reason to refuse. He said without thinking, "Okay.
I was just thinking about relying on you guys. Since you saved me, you can send Buddha to the West. Is it the kind that includes food and accommodation? "
Aizicheng listened in the cab: "Hey, you are really rude!
If you beat a snake, follow it with a stick.
You are lucky if you meet us. "
When I saw that this gentle Luo Yiwen was actually the type who could joke and was quite outgoing, I was filled with joy. Living in this impetuous materialistic age, it is not easy to meet a friend who doesn't talk about material things. Nowadays, even blind dates are materialistic. When we meet, the exchanges between you and me are just a few words:
"Have a room?"
"There is no mortgage for three bedrooms, and my parents can't live there."
"Hmm.
Have a car? "
